Description: The system shall prevent unintended leaving of the road.
The system shall identify sensor failures.
The system shall identify when the camera has failed.
The system shall mitigate sensor failures.
The system shall have more than one sensor used to identify the road lane.
The system shall inform the driver about sensor failures.
The system shall detect when the road lane cannot be identified unambiguously.
The system shall identify controller failures.
The system shall detect when the steering commands are not on time (tbd).
The system shall detect when the steering commands will bring the vehicle outside of road boundaries.
The system shall mitigate controller failures.
The system shall do a sanity check on the calculated speed profile to avoid leaving the road unintentionally.
The system shall identify failures of the steering actuators.
The system shall mitigate failures of the steering actuators.
The system shall identify failures of the motor control.
The system shall mitigate failures of the motor control.
The system shall identify failures of the brake actuators.
The system shall mitigate failures of the brake actuators.
The system shall drive through a pre-determined set of way points.
The system shall define a trajectory through a set of way points.
The system shall update the trajectory whenever the way points change or the vehicle has left the trajectory.
The system shall follow the defined trajectory.
The system shall translate the trajectory into vehicle commands.
The system shall provide longitudinal control value updates every 15 ms (tbc).
The system shall provide lateral control value updates every 5 ms (tbc).
The system shall calculate the correct steering angle to follow the trajectory.
The system shall calculate a speed profile to follow the trajectory.
The system shall control the vehicle using the calculated vehicle commands.
The system shall follow the pre-defined speed profile when moving in the defined trajectory.
The system shall be aware of key vehicle information such as steer/wheel/brake/acceleration status at any point in time.
The system shall be aware of its current position at all times.
